tmp:2306: parnasah beli torach — livelihood without toil, the effortless sustenance (manna, 'bread from heaven') attained through tikkun ha-brit
tmp:2308: parnasah be-nakel — livelihood obtained with ease, a state of sustenance dependent on expanded Da'at (the less da'at, the more toil)
tmp:2309: merirut'a de-alma — the bitterness of the world that must be sweetened by salt (Zohar dictum), applied to livelihood-in-sorrow as 'more bitter than death'
tmp:2311: tzeitekha — 'your going out' (Deut 33:18, 'Rejoice Zevulun'), the designation for commerce/business dealings as an outward activity vs. Torah's tents
tmp:2312: zeh — the demonstrative 'this' (Eccl 12:13 'this is the whole of man') as a title/symbol for the tzaddik, for whom the world was created as companion
tmp:2313: lulav — the palm branch of Sukkot's four species, symbolizing the tzaddik ('the righteous flourish like the date palm')
tmp:2314: keshet ha-brit — the rainbow of the covenant (sign of Noah), symbolizing the tzaddik who guards the brit
tmp:2315: efroach — a chick (Aramaic retzitza), symbol of the tzaddik via 'yifrach' — 'the righteous will flourish in his days' (Ps 72:7)
tmp:2316: tov — 'good' as an epithet of the tzaddik (matza tov = finding the righteous one), not mere moral goodness
tmp:2317: di-vchisha — 'that searches/burrows' (Aramaic, of the sea-goat in Rabbah b. bar Chanah's tale), symbolizing the tzaddik who constantly seeks out the beauty in every Jew
tmp:2318: tzeror kaspo — 'his bundle of silver' (Gen 42:35 / Prov 7:20), a symbol for the tzaddikim per Rashi, found within the emptied sack
tmp:2319: harim — mountains, as a symbol for the tzaddikim
tmp:2320: gader — a fence/wall (Aramaic guda, the shore the fish was cast onto), naming the tzaddik as the one who fences the breaches of Israel
tmp:2321: arba'ah she-nikhnesu la-pardes — the Talmudic episode (Chagigah 14b) of the four sages who entered the Pardes: R. Akiva, Ben Azzai, Ben Zoma, Acher
tmp:2322: tzaddik ve-rasha, oved Elokim ve-lo avado — the fourfold typology from Malachi 3:18 (righteous, wicked, server of God, non-server) mapped onto the four who entered Pardes
tmp:2323: tzaddik ve-ra lo — 'a righteous one who suffers,' the theodicy category identified here with the tzaddik whose halakhic opinion is not followed
tmp:2324: tzaddik she-ein halakhah kemoto — the tzaddik whose ruling is not accepted as halakhah, corresponding to 'the righteous one who suffers'
tmp:2325: tzaddik ve-tov lo — 'a righteous one who prospers,' the theodicy category identified with the tzaddik whose halakhic opinion prevails
tmp:2326: tzaddik she-halakhah kemoto — the tzaddik whose ruling is accepted as halakhah, corresponding to 'the righteous one who prospers'
tmp:2327: yerdu tehomot — 'they go down to the depths' (Ps 107:26), the phrase denoting the lower tzaddik between whom and the upper tzaddik the Shekhinah rests
tmp:2328: tzaddik tachton — the lower tzaddik (paired with the upper tzaddik), associated with kisses and 'dripping flowing myrrh'
tmp:2329: nehorei de'ah — 'lights/paths of Da'at' (pun on Nehardea in Shmuel's saying), the illumined paths of knowledge linked to tzedakah-mercy
tmp:2332: keren — horn (Aramaic karna), symbolizing tzedakah as the enduring 'principal' (keren) stored up for the World to Come (Munbaz)
tmp:2333: amud ha-shachar — the pillar of dawn/daybreak, a symbol for tzedakah ('then your light will break forth like the dawn,' Isa 58:8), which saves from wild beast and bandits
tmp:2334: kotzim — thorns (which the traveler fears), symbolizing the vegetative element (tzome'ach) and its bad traits
tmp:2335: tzome'ach — the vegetative kingdom, second of the four elements of creation (mineral-vegetable-animal-speaker), whose bad traits are nullified by gazing at the tzaddik
tmp:2336: tzurah — form (vs. chomer/matter), the soul-side of the man/animal, wisdom/foolishness, light/darkness dyad
tmp:2337: melaket ha-ruach — the gatherer of the spirit: the musician who ascends and descends the strings ('who gathered the wind in his palms,' Prov 30:4) to collect the good spirit
tmp:2338: shekhem — the shoulder ('on the shoulders of both,' also the place Shechem in Gen 37:13), symbolizing tzitzit as guard of the brit against sexual sin
tmp:2339: hargashat ha-yissurin — the felt sensation of sufferings, identified as the soul's thirst produced by saltiness/bitterness
tmp:2340: tzim'on ha-nefesh — the thirst of the soul, the burning felt in suffering, quenched by new Torah insights born of self-nullification
tmp:2341: needing counsel and not knowing how to act — a state of constricted intellect (tzimtzum), i.e., harsh judgments, sweetened by receiving advice from the sages
tmp:2342: tzimtzum ha-or li-tzedadin — the Lurianic contraction of the infinite light to the sides, creating the Vacated Space (chalal ha-panui) for creation
tmp:2343: tzimtzum shel chalal ha-panui — the contraction that formed the Vacated Space, source of the 'garments' (levushin) of divinity
tmp:2344: tza'akat ha-yoledet — the cry of a woman in labor; the cry one raises in prayer/Torah when the mochin withdraw into gestation, birthing renewed mentalities
tmp:2345: tza'ar kiflayim ka-yoledah — 'double the pain of a birthing woman': the anguish of worry and craving for livelihood (be-itzavon, dark countenance)
tmp:2346: tzipor de'ah — 'bird of knowledge,' Rebbe Nachman's wordplay on tzefarde'a (frog) in Rabbah bar bar Chanah's tale, the melody-bird of holy da'at
tmp:2347: dadei ha-malkhut — the breasts of Malkhut (Zohar), from which the impure birds of the kelipah suckle when a wicked musician draws his melody
tmp:2348: the requirement that the letters of speech be complete — perfection of speech (via the World to Come) needed to bring potential into actuality
tmp:2349: razin de-razin — 'secrets of secrets,' the designation for Kabbalah (vs. razin = Halakhah), which becomes enclothed within Halakhah
